name: Moneta Digital
oneLiner: MMXN is Moneta Digital's Mexican peso stablecoin, self-reporting 1:1 MXN bank reserves; no independent attestation cadence is currently published.
collateral: Mexican peso fiat reserves self-reported by Moneta Digital; per the issuer whitepaper the MXN reserves are custodied by Delchain and Deltec, financial-services firms regulated by the Securities Commission of the Bahamas, and a historical Armanino LLP reserve attestation engagement was disclosed (2021), but no current live attestation, proof-of-reserves feed, or ongoing third-party accounting cadence is published
pegMechanism: Issuer-managed 1:1 mint and redemption against MXN deposits, operated directly by Moneta Digital with TruBit as a SPEI-bank off-ramp partner; reserve composition and bank custodians are self-reported by the issuer with no independent attestation, audit cadence, or proof-of-reserves feed

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Possible retained: centralized issuer with discretionary mint/burn/pause authority on the ERC-20 contract (ERC20Mintable, ERC20Burnable, ERC20Pausable); holder-balance freeze surface not independently confirmed.

notices.title: Weaker attestation than tracked MXNB
notices.message: Moneta Digital self-reports MXN reserves without the formal quarterly audit cadence published by Bitso/Juno for MXNB. Reserve sufficiency and circulating supply consistency should be reviewed via on-chain explorers (Etherscan and Tronscan) until an independent attestation source is verified.

notices.title: Curated reserves are self-reported
notices.message: The curated-validated live-reserves adapter currently points at the issuer website root because no third-party attestation page has been verified for MMXN. Until an independent auditor or proof-of-reserves feed is published, the reserve composition reflects Moneta Digital's own disclosure only.

mintAuthority.summary: MMXN is issued by Moneta Digital against self-reported MXN bank reserves; the verified ERC-20 contract is mintable/burnable/pausable with role-gated minters, so supply is created at the issuer's discretion through privileged minter roles.

controls.label: Moneta Digital minter role (ERC20Mintable)
controls.evidence: Etherscan-verified non-proxy ERC-20 implements mint()/burn()/pause with addMinter/renounceMinter and addPauser/renouncePauser role management; new MMXN is created by issuer-held minter roles against off-chain MXN reserves.

review.evidence: Moneta Digital operates a centralized 1:1 mint/redeem against MXN bank deposits, and the on-chain token (Etherscan-verified) exposes mintable/burnable/pausable functionality gated by minter/pauser roles held by the issuer; no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route exists. Live role holders not independently read.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the live minter/pauser role holders and the Tron deployment's mint authority before raising confidence.
